column1: # flow_ref 1 source=tests/spec/flow_semantics/delay_receiver_twins.onsa tests=7 evaluated=2 unavailable=0 skipped=5 waiting=0
- prev~(x).when~(c) and pv~(x).when~(c) give the same, whether c starts false or true
- delay~(x, 2).reset_if~(r) and dl2~(x).reset_if~(r) give the same, for a reset at the first frame too
- both orders of when~ and reset_if~, and two when~, are the same on the delay and on the flow that holds it
@ a condition that always holds and a reset that never comes are no modifier
- vdelay~, a par~ of delays with two modifiers, and a delay in the first argument of a delay: the same as with the named flow
@ a delay of a value of sample / 4 and the conversion flow that holds it give the same, with a condition and a reset slower than the delay
- the twins agree when the calls of process cut the frames, and after a reset
